93	        for inter_id, inter_cat in self.cat.all_cats.items():

136	    def update_all_related_inheritance(self):
137	        """Update all the inheritances of the cats, which are related to the current cat."""
138	        # only adding/removing parents or kits will use this function, because all inheritances are based on parents
139	        for cat_id in self.all_involved:
140	            # Don't update the inheritance of faded cats
141	            # They are not viewable by the player and won't be used in any checks.
142	            if (
143	                cat_id in self.all_inheritances
144	                and self.cat.fetch_cat(cat_id)
145	                and not self.cat.fetch_cat(cat_id).faded
146	            ):
147	                if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].all_involved:
148	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].all_involved.remove(self.cat.ID)
149	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].all_but_cousins:
150	                        self.all_inheritances[cat_id].all_but_cousins.remove(
151	                            self.cat.ID
152	                        )
153	
154	                if cat_id in self.kits:
155	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_parents()
156	                if cat_id in self.grand_kits:
157	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].grandparents:
158	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].grandparents[self.cat.ID]
159	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_grandparents()
160	                if cat_id in self.mates:
161	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].mates:
162	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].mates[self.cat.ID]
163	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_mates()
164	                if cat_id in self.parents:
165	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].kits:
166	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].kits[self.cat.ID]
167	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_kits(self.cat.ID, self.cat)
168	                if cat_id in self.siblings:
169	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].siblings:
170	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].siblings[self.cat.ID]
171	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_siblings(self.cat.ID, self.cat)
172	                if cat_id in self.parents_siblings:
173	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].siblings_kits:
174	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].siblings_kits[self.cat.ID]
175	                    for par in self.parents:
176	                        if par in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].siblings:
177	                            self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_siblings(
178	                                par, self.cat.fetch_cat(par)
179	                            )
180	                if cat_id in self.siblings_kits:
181	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].parents_siblings:
182	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].parents_siblings[self.cat.ID]
183	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_parents_siblings(
184	                        self.cat.ID, self.cat
185	                    )
186	                if cat_id in self.cousins:
187	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].cousins:
188	                        del self.all_inheritances[cat_id].cousins[self.cat.ID]
189	                    self.all_inheritances[cat_id].init_cousins(self.cat.ID, self.cat)
190	                if cat_id in self.grand_parents:
191	                    if self.cat.ID in self.all_inheritances[cat_id].grand_kits:

331	    def init_parents(self):
332	        """Create parent relationships"""
333	        # by blood
334	        current_parent_ids = self.get_blood_parents()
335	        for relevant_id in current_parent_ids:
336	            relevant_cat = self.cat.fetch_cat(relevant_id)
337	            if not relevant_cat:
338	                continue
339	            self.parents[relevant_id] = {"type": RelationType.BLOOD, "additional": []}
340	            self.all_involved.append(relevant_id)
341	            self.all_but_cousins.append(relevant_id)
342	
343	        # adoptive
344	        current_parent_ids = self.get_adoptive_parents()
345	        for relevant_id in current_parent_ids:
346	            # if the cat is already a parent, continue
347	            if relevant_id in self.parents.keys():
348	                continue
349	            self.parents[relevant_id] = {
350	                "type": RelationType.ADOPTIVE,
351	                "additional": [],
352	            }
353	            self.all_involved.append(relevant_id)
354	            self.all_but_cousins.append(relevant_id)

356	    def init_mates(self):
357	        """Create a mate relationship"""
358	        for relevant_id in self.cat.mate:
359	            mate_rel = RelationType.NOT_BLOOD
360	            # they might be related, but only if it is not an adoption
361	            if relevant_id in self.all_involved:
362	                mate_rel = self.get_exact_rel_type(relevant_id)
363	            self.mates[relevant_id] = {
364	                "type": mate_rel,
365	                "additional": [i18n.t("inheritance.current_mate")],
366	            }
367	            self.other_mates.append(relevant_id)
368	
369	        for relevant_id in self.cat.previous_mates:
370	            mate_rel = RelationType.NOT_BLOOD
371	            # they might be related, but only if it is not an adoption
372	            if relevant_id in self.all_involved:
373	                mate_rel = self.get_exact_rel_type(relevant_id)
374	            self.mates[relevant_id] = {
375	                "type": mate_rel,
376	                "additional": [i18n.t("inheritance.prev_mate")],
377	            }
378	            self.other_mates.append(relevant_id)

380	    def init_grandparents(self):
381	        """Create a grandparent relationship."""
382	        for parent_id, value in self.parents.items():
383	            parent_cat = self.cat.fetch_cat(parent_id)
384	            if parent_cat is None:
385	                continue
386	            grandparents = self.get_parents(parent_cat)
387	            for grand_id in grandparents:
388	                if grand_id in self.parents.keys():
389	                    parent_relation = self.parents[grand_id]
390	                    if parent_relation["type"] == RelationType.BLOOD:
391	                        print(
392	                            "WARNING - How did this happen? "
393	                            "A grandparent is also the blood parent? Please report this!"
394	                        )
395	                    continue  # even it is not blood related, it is confusing
396	                grand_type = (
397	                    RelationType.BLOOD
398	                    if value["type"] == RelationType.BLOOD
399	                    else RelationType.NOT_BLOOD
400	                )
401	                if grand_id not in self.grand_parents:
402	                    self.grand_parents[grand_id] = {
403	                        "type": grand_type,
404	                        "additional": [],
405	                    }
406	                    self.all_involved.append(grand_id)
407	                    self.all_but_cousins.append(grand_id)
408	                self.grand_parents[grand_id]["additional"].append(
409	                    i18n.t("inheritance.parent_of_inter", name=str(parent_cat.name))
410	                )

412	    def init_kits(self, inter_id, inter_cat):
413	        """Create a kit relationship."""
414	        if not inter_cat:
415	            return
416	        # kits - blood
417	        inter_blood_parents = self.get_blood_parents(inter_cat)
418	        if self.cat.ID in inter_blood_parents:
419	            self.kits[inter_id] = {"type": RelationType.BLOOD, "additional": []}
420	            self.all_involved.append(inter_id)
421	            self.all_but_cousins.append(inter_id)
422	            if len(inter_blood_parents) > 1:
423	                inter_blood_parents.remove(self.cat.ID)
424	                other_id = inter_blood_parents.pop()
425	                other_cat = self.cat.fetch_cat(other_id)
426	                self.kits[inter_id]["additional"].append(
427	                    i18n.t("inheritance.second_parent", name=str(other_cat.name))
428	                )

430	        # kit - adoptive
431	        if self.cat.ID in inter_cat.adoptive_parents:
432	            self.kits[inter_id] = {"type": RelationType.ADOPTIVE, "additional": []}
433	            self.all_involved.append(inter_id)
434	            self.all_but_cousins.append(inter_id)
435	            if len(inter_blood_parents) > 0:
436	                name = []
437	                for blood_parent_id in inter_blood_parents:
438	                    blood_parent_cat = self.cat.fetch_cat(blood_parent_id)
439	                    if blood_parent_cat is None:

444	                    i18n.t(

448	                    )
449	                )

453	            for mate_id in inter_cat.mate:

455	                # they might be related, but only if it is not an adoption
456	                if mate_id in self.all_involved:
457	                    if mate_id in self.parents.keys():
458	                        rel_type = self.parents[mate_id]["type"]
459	                    else:
460	                        rel_type = self.get_exact_rel_type(mate_id)
461	                self.kits_mates[mate_id] = {
462	                    "type": rel_type,
463	                    "additional": [
464	                        i18n.t("inheritance.mate_of_inter", name=str(inter_cat.name))
465	                    ],
466	                }

468	    def init_siblings(self, inter_id, inter_cat):
469	        """Create a sibling relationship."""
470	        if not inter_cat:
471	            return
472	
473	        # if the cat is in the parents, don't continue
474	        if inter_id in self.parents.keys():
475	            return
476	
477	        # blood / half-blood
478	        current_parent_ids = self.get_blood_parents()
479	        inter_parent_ids = self.get_blood_parents(inter_cat)
480	        blood_parent_overlap = set(current_parent_ids) & set(inter_parent_ids)
481	
482	        # adopt
483	        adoptive_overlap1 = set(current_parent_ids) & set(inter_cat.adoptive_parents)
484	        adoptive_overlap2 = set(self.cat.adoptive_parents) & set(inter_parent_ids)
485	        adoptive_overlap3 = set(self.cat.adoptive_parents) & set(
486	            inter_cat.adoptive_parents
487	        )
488	
489	        siblings = False
490	        rel_type = RelationType.BLOOD
491	        additional_info = []
492	        if len(blood_parent_overlap) == 2:
493	            siblings = True
494	            if (
495	                inter_cat.moons + inter_cat.dead_for
496	                == self.cat.moons + self.cat.dead_for
497	            ):
498	                additional_info.append(i18n.t("inheritance.littermates"))
499	        elif (
500	            len(blood_parent_overlap) == 1
501	            and len(inter_parent_ids) == 1
502	            and len(current_parent_ids) == 1
503	        ):
504	            siblings = True
505	            if (
506	                inter_cat.moons + inter_cat.dead_for
507	                == self.cat.moons + self.cat.dead_for
508	            ):
509	                additional_info.append(i18n.t("inheritance.littermates"))
510	        elif len(blood_parent_overlap) == 1 and (
511	            len(inter_parent_ids) > 1 or len(current_parent_ids) > 1
512	        ):
513	            siblings = True
514	            rel_type = RelationType.HALF_BLOOD
515	        elif (
516	            len(adoptive_overlap1) > 0
517	            or len(adoptive_overlap2) > 0
518	            or len(adoptive_overlap3) > 0
519	        ):
520	            siblings = True
521	            rel_type = RelationType.ADOPTIVE
522	
523	        if siblings:
524	            self.siblings[inter_id] = {"type": rel_type, "additional": additional_info}
525	            self.all_involved.append(inter_id)
526	            self.all_but_cousins.append(inter_id)
527	
528	            for mate_id in inter_cat.mate:
529	                mate_rel = RelationType.NOT_BLOOD
530	                # they might be related, but only if it is not an adoption
531	                if mate_id in self.all_involved:
532	                    if mate_id in self.parents.keys():
533	                        mate_rel = self.parents[mate_id]["type"]
534	                    else:
535	                        mate_rel = self.get_exact_rel_type(mate_id)
536	                self.siblings_mates[mate_id] = {
537	                    "type": mate_rel,
538	                    "additional": [
539	                        i18n.t("inheritance.mate_of_inter", name=str(inter_cat.name))
540	                    ],
541	                }
542	                self.other_mates.append(mate_id)
543	
544	            # iterate over all cats, to get the children of the sibling
545	            for _c in self.cat.all_cats.values():
546	                _c_parents = self.get_parents(_c)
547	                _c_adoptive = self.get_adoptive_parents(_c)
548	                if inter_id in _c_parents:
549	                    parents_cats = [self.cat.fetch_cat(c_id) for c_id in _c_parents]
550	                    parent_cats_names = [str(c.name) for c in parents_cats]
551	                    kit_rel_type = (
552	                        RelationType.BLOOD
553	                        if rel_type in BLOOD_RELATIVE_TYPES
554	                        else RelationType.NOT_BLOOD
555	                    )
556	                    if inter_id in _c_adoptive:
557	                        kit_rel_type = RelationType.ADOPTIVE
558	
559	                    add_info = ""
560	                    if len(parent_cats_names) > 0:
561	                        add_info = i18n.t(
562	                            "inheritance.child_of_inter",
563	                            name=adjust_list_text(parent_cats_names),
564	                        )
565	                    self.siblings_kits[_c.ID] = {
566	                        "type": kit_rel_type,
567	                        "additional": [add_info],
568	                    }
569	                    self.all_involved.append(_c.ID)
570	                    self.all_but_cousins.append(_c.ID)

572	    def init_parents_siblings(self, inter_id, inter_cat):
573	        """Create an aunt/uncle (pibling) relationship."""
574	        if not inter_cat:
575	            return
576	        inter_parent_ids = self.get_parents(inter_cat)
577	        for inter_parent_id in inter_parent_ids:
578	            # check if the parent of the inter cat is the grandparent of the relevant cat
579	            if (
580	                inter_parent_id in self.grand_parents.keys()
581	                and inter_id not in self.parents.keys()
582	            ):
583	                # the inter cat is an uncle/aunt of the current cat
584	                # only create a new entry if there is no entry for this cat - shouldn't be but safety check
585	                if inter_id not in self.parents_siblings:
586	                    # get the relation type of the grandparent to assume how they are related
587	                    rel_type = RelationType.BLOOD
588	
589	                    # create new entity
590	                    self.parents_siblings[inter_id] = {
591	                        "type": rel_type,
592	                        "additional": [],
593	                    }
594	                    self.all_involved.append(inter_id)
595	                    self.all_but_cousins.append(inter_id)
596

908	        """Get a list of valid parents for the current cat"""

913	            == self.the_cat.status.group_ID  # Adoptive parents must be part of the same group
914	            and inter_cat.ID != self.the_cat.ID  # Can't be your own adoptive parent
915	            and inter_cat.moons - self.the_cat.moons
916	            >= 14  # Adoptive parent must be at least 14 moons older. -> own child can't adopt you
917	            and inter_cat.ID
918	            not in self.the_cat.mate  # Can't set your mate your adoptive parent.
919	            and inter_cat.ID
920	            not in self.the_cat.get_parents()  # Adoptive parents can't already be their parent
921	            and self.not_related_to_mate(
922	                inter_cat
923	            )  # quick fix TODO: change / remove later
924	            and (
925	                not self.mates_current_parents
926	                or self.is_parent_mate(self.the_cat, inter_cat)
927	            )  # Toggle for only mates of current parents
928	            and (
929	                not self.unrelated_only
930	                or inter_cat.ID not in self.the_cat.get_relatives()
931	            )

from typing import Dict

import i18n
import pygame.transform
import pygame_gui.elements

from scripts.cat.cats import Cat
from scripts.game_structure import image_cache
from scripts.game_structure.propagating_thread import PropagatingThread
from ..ui.elements.sprite_button import UISpriteButton
from ..ui.elements.image_button import UIImageButton
from ..ui.elements.surface_image_button import UISurfaceImageButton
from ..ui.theme import get_text_box_theme
from ..ui.scale import ui_scale, ui_scale_dimensions, ui_scale_offset
from .Screens import Screens
from .enums import GameScreen
from ..game_structure.game.switches import switch_set_value, switch_get_value, Switch
from ..game_structure.screen_settings import MANAGER
from ..ui.generate_box import BoxStyles, get_box
from ..ui.generate_button import get_button_dict, ButtonStyles
from ..ui.icon import Icon


class ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen(Screens):
    def __init__(self, name=None):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.next_cat = None
        self.previous_cat = None
        self.next_cat_button = None
        self.previous_cat_button = None
        self.the_cat = None
        self.selected_cat = None
        self.back_button = None

        self.toggle_adoptive_parent = None
        self.page_number = None

        self.parent_frame = None
        self.the_cat_frame = None
        self.info = None
        self.help_button = None
        self.checkboxes = {}

        self.current_cat_elements = {}
        self.selected_cat_elements = {}

        self.adoptive_parents_tab_button = None
        self.birth_parents_tab_button = None
        self.potential_parents_tab_button = None

        # Keep track of all the cats we want to display
        self.all_adoptive_parents = []
        self.all_potential_parents = []

        # Keep track of the current page on all three tabs
        self.adoptive_page = 0
        self.potential_parents_page = 0

        self.birth_parents_buttons = {}
        self.adoptive_parents_buttons = {}
        self.potential_parents_buttons = {}

        # Tab containers.
        self.adoptive_container = None
        self.birth_container = None
        self.potential_container = None

        self.list_frame = None

        self.center_icon = None

        # Filter toggles
        self.mates_current_parents = False
        self.unrelated_only = False

        self.mates_current_parents_text = None

        self.adoptive_page_display = None
        self.potential_page_display = None

        # Keep track of the open tab
        # Can be "potential" for the potential mates tab, "offspring"
        # for the offspring tab, and "mates" for the mate tab.
        self.open_tab = "potential"
        self.tab_buttons = {}

        self.work_thread = PropagatingThread()

    def handle_event(self, event):
        """Handles events."""
        if event.type == pygame_gui.UI_BUTTON_START_PRESS:
            self.mute_button_pressed(event)

            # Cat buttons list
            if event.ui_element == self.back_button:
                self.selected_mate_index = 0
                self.change_screen(GameScreen.PROFILE)
            elif event.ui_element == self.toggle_adoptive_parent:
                if self.work_thread is not None and self.work_thread.is_alive():
                    return
                self.work_thread = self.loading_screen_start_work(
                    self.change_adoptive_parent
                )

            elif event.ui_element == self.previous_cat_button:
                if isinstance(Cat.fetch_cat(self.previous_cat), Cat):
                    switch_set_value(Switch.cat, self.previous_cat)
                    self.update_current_cat_info()
                else:
                    print("invalid previous cat", self.previous_cat)
            elif event.ui_element == self.next_cat_button:
                if isinstance(Cat.fetch_cat(self.next_cat), Cat):
                    switch_set_value(Switch.cat, self.next_cat)
                    self.update_current_cat_info()
                else:
                    print("invalid next cat", self.next_cat)

            # Checkboxes
            elif event.ui_element == self.checkboxes.get("mates_current_parents"):
                self.mates_current_parents = not self.mates_current_parents
                self.update_potential_parents_container()
            elif event.ui_element == self.checkboxes.get("unrelated_only"):
                self.unrelated_only = not self.unrelated_only
                self.update_potential_parents_container()

            # Next and last page buttons
            elif event.ui_element == self.potential_next_page:
                self.potential_parents_page += 1
                self.update_potential_mates_container_page()
            elif event.ui_element == self.potential_last_page:
                self.potential_parents_page -= 1
                self.update_potential_mates_container_page()
            elif event.ui_element == self.adoptive_next_page:
                self.adoptive_page += 1
                self.update_adoptive_parents_container_page()
            elif event.ui_element == self.adoptive_last_page:
                self.adoptive_page -= 1
                self.update_adoptive_parents_container_page()

            elif event.ui_element == self.tab_buttons.get("birth"):
                self.open_tab = "birth"
                self.switch_tab()
            elif event.ui_element == self.tab_buttons.get("adoptive"):
                self.open_tab = "adoptive"
                self.switch_tab()
            elif event.ui_element == self.tab_buttons.get("potential"):
                self.open_tab = "potential"
                self.switch_tab()
            elif (
                event.ui_element in self.potential_parents_buttons.values()
                or event.ui_element in self.adoptive_parents_buttons.values()
            ):
                self.selected_cat = event.ui_element.cat_object
                self.update_selected_cat()
            elif event.ui_element in self.birth_parents_buttons.values():
                switch_set_value(Switch.cat, event.ui_element.cat_object.ID)
                self.change_screen(GameScreen.PROFILE)

    def screen_switches(self):
        """Sets up the elements that are always on the page"""
        super().screen_switches()
        self.show_mute_buttons()
        list_frame = get_box(BoxStyles.ROUNDED_BOX, (650, 194))

        self.list_frame = pygame_gui.elements.UIImage(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((75, 391), (650, 194))), list_frame
        )
        del list_frame
        self.info = pygame_gui.elements.UITextBox(
            "screens.choose_adoptive_parent.info",
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((200, 60), (400, 100))),
            object_id=get_text_box_theme("#text_box_22_horizcenter_spacing_95"),
        )

        self.help_button = UIImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((725, 70), (34, 34))),
            "",
            object_id="#help_button",
            manager=MANAGER,
            tool_tip_text="screens.choose_adoptive_parent.help_tooltip",
        )

        self.the_cat_frame = pygame_gui.elements.UIImage(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((40, 113), (266, 197))),
            pygame.transform.scale(
                image_cache.load_image(
                    "resources/images/choosing_cat1_frame_mate.png"
                ).convert_alpha(),
                (532, 394),
            ),
        )
        self.parent_frame = pygame_gui.elements.UIImage(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((494, 113), (266, 197))),
            pygame.transform.scale(
                image_cache.load_image(
                    "resources/images/choosing_cat2_frame_mate.png"
                ).convert_alpha(),
                (532, 394),
            ),
        )

        self.center_icon = pygame_gui.elements.UIImage(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((306, 160), (188, 129))),
            pygame.transform.scale(
                image_cache.load_image("resources/images/adoption.png").convert_alpha(),
                ui_scale_dimensions((376, 258)),
            ),
            manager=MANAGER,
        )

        self.next_cat_button = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((622, 25), (153, 30))),
            "buttons.next_cat",
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.SQUOVAL, (153, 30)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_squoval",
            manager=MANAGER,
            sound_id="page_flip",
        )
        self.previous_cat_button = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((25, 25), (153, 30))),
            "buttons.previous_cat",
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.SQUOVAL, (153, 30)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_squoval",
            manager=MANAGER,
            sound_id="page_flip",
        )
        self.back_button = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((25, 60), (105, 30))),
            "buttons.back",
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.SQUOVAL, (105, 30)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_squoval",
            manager=MANAGER,
        )

        # Tab containers:
        contain_rect = ui_scale(pygame.Rect((85, 400), (630, 219)))

        self.adoptive_container = pygame_gui.core.UIContainer(contain_rect, MANAGER)

        # All the perm elements the exist inside self.mates_container
        self.adoptive_next_page = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((366, 179), (34, 34))),
            Icon.ARROW_RIGHT,
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.ICON, (34, 34)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_icon",
            container=self.adoptive_container,
        )
        self.adoptive_last_page = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((230, 179), (34, 34))),
            Icon.ARROW_LEFT,
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.ICON, (34, 34)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_icon",
            container=self.adoptive_container,
        )

        self.birth_container = pygame_gui.core.UIContainer(contain_rect, MANAGER)

        self.potential_container = pygame_gui.core.UIContainer(contain_rect, MANAGER)

        # All the perm elements the exist inside self.potential_container
        self.potential_next_page = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((366, 179), (34, 34))),
            Icon.ARROW_RIGHT,
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.ICON, (34, 34)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_icon",
            container=self.potential_container,
        )
        self.potential_last_page = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((230, 179), (34, 34))),
            Icon.ARROW_LEFT,
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.ICON, (34, 34)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_icon",
            container=self.potential_container,
        )
        self.potential_seperator = pygame_gui.elements.UIImage(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((497, 0), (10, 176))),
            pygame.transform.scale(
                image_cache.load_image("resources/images/vertical_bar.png"),
                ui_scale_dimensions((20, 352)),
            ),
            container=self.potential_container,
        )

        # Checkboxes and text
        self.mates_current_parents_text = pygame_gui.elements.UITextBox(
            "screens.choose_adoptive_parent.mates_current_parents",
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((515, 5), (110, -1))),
            object_id="#text_box_26_horizcenter",
            container=self.potential_container,
        )

        self.unrelated_only_text = pygame_gui.elements.UITextBox(
            "screens.choose_adoptive_parent.unrelated",
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((515, 85), (110, -1))),
            object_id="#text_box_26_horizcenter",
            container=self.potential_container,
        )

        # Page numbers
        self.adoptive_page = 0
        self.potential_parents_page = 0

        # This may be deleted and changed later.
        self.toggle_adoptive_parent = UISurfaceImageButton(
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((303, 310), (192, 30))),
            "screens.choose_adoptive_parent.set_parent",
            get_button_dict(ButtonStyles.SQUOVAL, (192, 30)),
            object_id="@buttonstyles_squoval",
        )

        self.open_tab = "potential"

        # This will set up everything else on the page. Basically everything that changed with selected or
        # current cat
        self.update_current_cat_info()

    def display_change_save(self):
        variable_dict = super().display_change_save()

        variable_dict["primary_cat"] = self.the_cat
        variable_dict["selected_cat"] = self.selected_cat
        variable_dict["adopted_page"] = self.adoptive_page
        variable_dict["parent_mate_checkbox"] = self.mates_current_parents
        variable_dict["not_related_checkbox"] = self.unrelated_only
        variable_dict["open_tab"] = self.open_tab

        return variable_dict

    def display_change_load(self, variable_dict: Dict):
        super().display_change_load(variable_dict)

        self.selected_cat = variable_dict["selected_cat"]
        self.the_cat = variable_dict["primary_cat"]

        self.open_tab = variable_dict["open_tab"]

        self.mates_current_parents = variable_dict["parent_mate_checkbox"]
        self.unrelated_only = variable_dict["not_related_checkbox"]

        self.update_current_cat_info(reset_selected_cat=False)
        self.update_selected_cat()

    def change_adoptive_parent(self):
        """Make adoptive parent changes"""
        if not self.selected_cat:
            return

        if self.selected_cat.ID not in self.the_cat.adoptive_parents:
            self.the_cat.set_adoptive_parent(self.selected_cat)

        else:
            self.the_cat.unset_adoptive_parent(self.selected_cat)

    def update_after_change(self):
        """Updates that need to be run after setting an adoptive parent"""

        self.draw_tab_button()
        self.update_toggle_button()
        self.update_potential_parents_container()
        self.update_adoptive_parents_container()

    def update_birth_container(self):
        """Updates everything in the mates container, including the list of current mates,
        and the page"""

        for ele in self.birth_parents_buttons:
            self.birth_parents_buttons[ele].kill()
        self.birth_parents_buttons = {}

        birth_parents = [
            Cat.fetch_cat(i)
            for i in (self.the_cat.parent1, self.the_cat.parent2)
            if isinstance(Cat.fetch_cat(i), Cat)
        ]

        if len(birth_parents) == 1:
            self.birth_parents_buttons["cat"] = UISpriteButton(
                ui_scale(pygame.Rect((240, 13), (150, 150))),
                pygame.transform.scale(
                    birth_parents[0].sprite, ui_scale_dimensions((150, 150))
                ),
                cat_object=birth_parents[0],
                manager=MANAGER,
                container=self.birth_container,
                tool_tip_text=str(birth_parents[0].name),
            )
            if birth_parents[0].faded:
                self.birth_parents_buttons["cat"].disable()
        elif len(birth_parents) >= 2:
            x_pos = 150
            for i, _par in enumerate(birth_parents):
                self.birth_parents_buttons["cat" + str(i)] = UISpriteButton(
                    ui_scale(pygame.Rect((x_pos, 13), (150, 150))),
                    pygame.transform.scale(
                        _par.sprite, ui_scale_dimensions((150, 150))
                    ),
                    cat_object=_par,
                    manager=MANAGER,
                    container=self.birth_container,
                    tool_tip_text=str(_par.name),
                    starting_height=2,
                )
                if _par.faded:
                    self.birth_parents_buttons["cat" + str(i)].disable()
                x_pos += 115

    def update_adoptive_parents_container(self):
        """Updates everything in the mates container, including the list of current mates, checkboxes
        and the page"""

        self.all_adoptive_parents = self.chunks(
            [
                Cat.fetch_cat(i)
                for i in self.the_cat.adoptive_parents
                if isinstance(Cat.fetch_cat(i), Cat)
            ],
            30,
        )

        self.update_adoptive_parents_container_page()

    def update_adoptive_parents_container_page(self):
        """Updates just the current page for the mates container, does
        not refresh the list. It will also update the disable status of the
        next and last page buttons"""
        for ele in self.adoptive_parents_buttons:
            self.adoptive_parents_buttons[ele].kill()
        self.adoptive_parents_buttons = {}

        total_pages = len(self.all_adoptive_parents)
        if max(1, total_pages) - 1 < self.adoptive_page:
            self.adoptive_page = total_pages - 1
        elif self.adoptive_page < 0:
            self.adoptive_page = 0

        if total_pages <= 1:
            self.adoptive_last_page.disable()
            self.adoptive_next_page.disable()
        elif self.adoptive_page >= total_pages - 1:
            self.adoptive_last_page.enable()
            self.adoptive_next_page.disable()
        elif self.adoptive_page <= 0:

    def draw_tab_button(self):
        """Draw the tab buttons, and will switch the currently open tab if the button is
        not supposed to show up."""

        for x in self.tab_buttons:
            self.tab_buttons[x].kill()
        self.tab_buttons = {}

        button_rect = ui_scale(pygame.Rect((0, 0), (153, 39)))
        button_rect.bottomleft = ui_scale_offset((100, 8))

        adoptive_parents_shown = False

        if self.the_cat.adoptive_parents:

        birth_parents_shown = False

        if (self.open_tab == "birth" and not birth_parents_shown) or (

        self.switch_tab()

    def switch_tab(self):
        if self.open_tab == "birth":
            self.birth_container.show()
            self.adoptive_container.hide()
            self.potential_container.hide()

            if "birth" in self.tab_buttons:
                self.tab_buttons["birth"].disable()
            if "adoptive" in self.tab_buttons:
                self.tab_buttons["adoptive"].enable()
            self.tab_buttons["potential"].enable()
        elif self.open_tab == "adoptive":
            self.birth_container.hide()
            self.adoptive_container.show()
            self.potential_container.hide()

            if "birth" in self.tab_buttons:
                self.tab_buttons["birth"].enable()
            if "adoptive" in self.tab_buttons:
                self.tab_buttons["adoptive"].disable()
            self.tab_buttons["potential"].enable()
        else:
            self.birth_container.hide()
            self.adoptive_container.hide()
            self.potential_container.show()

            if "birth" in self.tab_buttons:

            ]
        )
        self.selected_cat_elements["info"] = pygame_gui.elements.UITextBox(
            info,
            ui_scale(pygame.Rect((206, 175), (94, 100))),
            object_id="#text_box_22_horizcenter_vertcenter_spacing_95",
            manager=MANAGER,
        )

    def on_use(self):
        super().on_use()

        self.loading_screen_on_use(self.work_thread, self.update_after_change)

    def get_valid_adoptive_parents(self):
        """Get a list of valid parents for the current cat"""
        valid_parents = [
            inter_cat
            for inter_cat in Cat.all_cats_list
            if inter_cat.status.group_ID
            == self.the_cat.status.group_ID  # Adoptive parents must be part of the same group
            and inter_cat.ID != self.the_cat.ID  # Can't be your own adoptive parent
            and inter_cat.moons - self.the_cat.moons
            >= 14  # Adoptive parent must be at least 14 moons older. -> own child can't adopt you
            and inter_cat.ID
            not in self.the_cat.mate  # Can't set your mate your adoptive parent.
            and inter_cat.ID
            not in self.the_cat.get_parents()  # Adoptive parents can't already be their parent
            and self.not_related_to_mate(
                inter_cat
            )  # quick fix TODO: change / remove later
            and (
                not self.mates_current_parents
                or self.is_parent_mate(self.the_cat, inter_cat)
            )  # Toggle for only mates of current parents
            and (
                not self.unrelated_only
                or inter_cat.ID not in self.the_cat.get_relatives()
            )
        ]  # Toggle for only not-closely-related.

        return valid_parents

    def not_related_to_mate(self, possible_parent) -> bool:
        """
        This should prevent weird combinations, till the pop-up is implemented.
        It checks the potential parent is a relative of your mate.
        Return if the cat is a possible adoptive parent.
        """
        if len(self.the_cat.mate) > 0:
            for mate_id in self.the_cat.mate:
                mate = Cat.fetch_cat(mate_id)
                mate_relatives = mate.get_relatives()
                if possible_parent.ID in mate_relatives:
                    return False

        return True

    @staticmethod
    def is_parent_mate(the_cat: Cat, other_cat: Cat):
        """Checks to see if other_cat is the mate of any of current parents"""
        for x in the_cat.get_parents():
            ob = Cat.fetch_cat(x)
            if not isinstance(ob, Cat):
                continue
            if other_cat.ID in ob.mate:
                return True

        return False

def fetch_cat(ID: str):
        """Fetches a cat object. Works for both faded and non-faded cats. Returns none if no cat was found."""
        if not ID or isinstance(ID, Cat):  # Check if argument is None or Cat.
            return ID
        elif not isinstance(ID, str):  # Invalid type
            return None
        if ID in Cat.all_cats:
            return Cat.all_cats[ID]
        else:
            return ob if (ob := Cat.load_faded_cat(ID)) else None

    @staticmethod
    def load_faded_cat(cat: str):
        """Loads a faded cat, returning the cat object. This object is saved nowhere else."""

        # just preventing any attempts to load something that isn't a cat ID
        if not cat.isdigit():
            return

        try:
            # todo: why can't this be `get_switch(Switch.clan_name)`?
            clan = (
                switch_get_value(Switch.clan_list)[0]
                if game.clan is None
                else game.clan.name
            )

            with open(
                get_save_dir() + "/" + clan + "/faded_cats/" + cat + ".json",
                "r",
                encoding="utf-8",
            ) as read_file:
                cat_info = ujson.loads(read_file.read())
                # If loading cats is attempted before the Clan is loaded, we would need to use this.

        except (
            AttributeError
        ):  # NOPE, cats are always loaded before the Clan, so doesn't make sense to throw an error
            with open(
                get_save_dir()
                + "/"
                + switch_get_value(Switch.clan_list)[0]
                + "/faded_cats/"
                + cat
                + ".json",
                "r",
                encoding="utf-8",
            ) as read_file:
                cat_info = ujson.loads(read_file.read())
        except:
            print("ERROR: in loading faded cat")
            return False

        if isinstance(cat_info["status"], str):
            status_dict = {"rank": cat_info["status"]}
        else:
            status_dict = cat_info["status"]

        cat_ob = Cat(
            ID=cat_info["ID"],
            prefix=cat_info["name_prefix"],
            suffix=cat_info["name_suffix"],
            status_dict=status_dict,
            moons=cat_info["moons"],
            faded=True,
        )
        if cat_info["parent1"]:
            cat_ob.parent1 = cat_info["parent1"]
        if cat_info["parent2"]:
            cat_ob.parent2 = cat_info["parent2"]
        cat_ob.faded_offspring = cat_info["faded_offspring"]
        cat_ob.adoptive_parents = (
            cat_info["adoptive_parents"] if "adoptive_parents" in cat_info else []
        )
        cat_ob.faded = True

Here are my findings for the parent-editing / parent-display code paths in the Clangen codebase.

## 1. Screen(s) that set/unset a cat's parents

The only in-game screen that edits parentage is the adoptive-parent editor. There is no UI to edit bio parent1/parent2 (those come from birth/load only).

- **`/app/scripts/screens/ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen.py`** — class `ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen`.
  - `change_adoptive_parent()` at **lines 343-352** — the toggle handler. If the selected cat is not already an adoptive parent it calls `self.the_cat.set_adoptive_parent(...)`, otherwise `self.the_cat.unset_adoptive_parent(...)`. This is the "unset one of the parents" action.
  - `update_after_change()` at **lines 354-360** — refreshes containers after the toggle.
  - `update_birth_container()` at **lines 362-405** — displays bio `parent1`/`parent2` (read-only).
  - `get_valid_adoptive_parents()` at **lines 907-934** and `is_parent_mate()` at **lines 951-961** (the "mates of current parents" filter).
- **`/app/scripts/screens/ProfileScreen.py`** — the entry point. Button handler at **lines 244-245** routes to `GameScreen.CHOOSE_ADOPTIVE_PARENT`. Family tree button at **lines 238-239** goes to `FamilyTreeScreen` (view-only, no editing).

## 2. Code that unsets a parent + the data structures

Data structures on the `Cat` object (**`/app/scripts/cat/cats.py`**):
- `self.parent1`, `self.parent2` — bio parent IDs (set at lines 196-197, defaulted None at 384-385).
- `self.adoptive_parents` — list of adoptive parent IDs (lines 198, 386).
- `self.moons` is separate age data. Parents are also mirrored in the `Inheritance` object (`self.inheritance`).

Unset logic:
- `Cat.unset_adoptive_parent()` at **`/app/scripts/cat/cats.py:2580-2599`** — does `self.adoptive_parents.remove(other_cat.ID)`, then calls `self.create_inheritance_new_cat()` and `other_cat.create_inheritance_new_cat()`, then adjusts relationships.
- `Cat.set_adoptive_parent()` at **lines 2601+**.
- `Inheritance.remove_parent()` at **`/app/scripts/cat_relations/inheritance.py:249-253`** and `add_parent()` at **255-272**.
- Blood-parent resolution: `Inheritance.get_blood_parents()` at **`inheritance.py:697-707`**. Note the asymmetric logic: if `parent1` is falsy it returns `[]` even when `parent2` is set — a real correctness bug if a bio parent1 is ever cleared while parent2 remains.
- `Inheritance.get_parents()` at **lines 715-723** = blood + adoptive. `Cat.get_parents()` at **`cats.py:1769-1773`** delegates to `self.inheritance.parents.keys()`.
- `Inheritance.init_parents()` at **`inheritance.py:331-354`** rebuilds the `parents` dict (BLOOD entries from `get_blood_parents`, then ADOPTIVE).

## 3. The "parents: X, Y, and Z" profile display + bio-mom/dad's-mate logic

- **`/app/scripts/screens/ProfileScreen.py:798-806`** builds the parent line:
  ```python
  all_parents = [Cat.fetch_cat(i) for i in the_cat.get_parents()]
  if all_parents:
      output += i18n.t("screens.profile.parent_label", count=len(all_parents),
                       parents=adjust_list_text([str(cat.name) for cat in all_parents]))
  ```
  The `parent_label` string is at `/app/resources/lang/en/screens/profile.en.json:36-38`. This is a likely crash site: `get_parents()` returns raw IDs from the inheritance dict; if `Cat.fetch_cat(i)` returns `None` (a dangling/faded ID left behind after unsetting), then `str(cat.name)` at line 805 raises `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'name'`.
- The "bio mom / bio dad / their mates" relationship semantics live in the inheritance module, not a single labeled block. Blood vs adoptive typing is `RelationType` at **`inheritance.py:20-29`**. The "second parent" / co-parent-by-mate and "current mate/previous mate" additional descriptors are assembled in `init_mates()` (**356-378**), `init_kits()` (**412-450**, plus the `inter_cat.mate` loops at **453** and **528**), and surfaced via `get_cat_info()` (**208-247**). Strings: `/app/resources/lang/en/inheritance.en.json` (`current_mate`, `prev_mate`, `second_parent`, `blood_parent`).

## Most probable crash mechanism
After `unset_adoptive_parent` (ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen.py:352) rebuilds inheritance, either:
1. `ProfileScreen.py:799/805` dereferences a `None` from `Cat.fetch_cat` on a still-listed parent ID, or
2. `inheritance.get_blood_parents` (inheritance.py:703-707) drops a valid `parent2` when `parent1` is empty, producing an inconsistent parents dict.

I'd start debugging at **`ProfileScreen.py:799-805`** (add an `isinstance(cat, Cat)` guard like the one already used in `update_birth_container` at line 373) and audit **`inheritance.py:697-707`**.

    # test that a cat with 1-5 moons has the age of a kitten
    def test_kitten(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=5, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.KITTEN)

    # test that a cat with 6-11 moons has the age of an adolescent
    def test_adolescent(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=6, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.ADOLESCENT)

    # test that a cat with 12-47 moons has the age of a young adult
    def test_young_adult(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=12, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.YOUNG_ADULT)

    # test that a cat with 48-95 moons has the age of an adult
    def test_adult(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=48, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.ADULT)

    # test that a cat with 96-119 moons has the age of a senior adult
    def test_senior_adult(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=96, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.SENIOR_ADULT)

    # test that a cat with 120-300 moons has the age of a senior
    def test_elder(self):
        test_cat = Cat(moons=120, disable_random=True)
        self.assertEqual(test_cat.age, CatAge.SENIOR)


class TestRelativesFunction(unittest.TestCase):
    # test that is_parent returns True for a parent1-cat relationship and False otherwise
    def test_is_parent(self):
        parent = Cat(disable_random=True)
        kit = Cat(parent1=parent.ID, disable_random=True)
        self.assertFalse(kit.is_parent(kit))
        self.assertFalse(kit.is_parent(parent))
        self.assertTrue(parent.is_parent(kit))

    # test that is_sibling returns True for cats with a shared parent1 and False otherwise
    def test_is_sibling(self):
        parent = Cat(disable_random=True)
        kit1 = Cat(parent1=parent.ID, disable_random=True)

steps.message:
All three crash sites confirmed. Summary of the defect:

- **Root cause** — `Inheritance.init_parents()` validates *blood* parents (`if not relevant_cat: continue`) but the **adoptive** branch blindly adds every ID, so an unresolvable parent reference (a cat that was removed/lost with no faded file) enters the `parents` dict.
- That phantom ID then reaches unguarded UI: `ProfileScreen`'s "parents:" line (`str(cat.name)` on `None`) and `ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen`'s entry loop (`parent_ob.faded` on `None`) — the latter is exactly the "unset a parent" screen.

Both are inconsistent with the rest of the code, which guards these lists (`update_birth_container`, siblings/offspring lists all use `isinstance(..., Cat)`).

Let me create a task list and implement the fixes.

steps.message:
I've fixed the crash. Here's what was happening and what I changed.

## Root cause

The cat in the screenshot has four parents — two blood (bio mom/dad) and two adoptive (their mates). The crash comes from an **unresolvable parent reference**: a parent ID that `Cat.fetch_cat()` returns `None` for (a cat that was removed with no faded-cat file behind it).

`Inheritance.init_parents()` validated blood parents (`if not relevant_cat: continue`) but the **adoptive branch blindly added every ID** to the `parents` dict. That phantom ID then flowed into two UI spots that didn't guard against `None` — inconsistent with the rest of the codebase, which already guards these lists (`update_birth_container`, and the siblings/offspring/mentor lists in `ProfileScreen`):

- `ProfileScreen`'s "parents:" line → `str(cat.name)` on `None` → `AttributeError`
- `ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen.update_current_cat_info` (the *unset-a-parent* screen) → `parent_ob.faded` on `None` → `AttributeError`

Since the work thread re-raises exceptions onto the main thread, either one closes the game.

## Fixes (3 files, 12 lines)

1. **`inheritance.py` — root cause.** `init_parents()` now skips adoptive IDs that don't resolve to a real cat, mirroring the existing blood-parent guard. Phantom cats no longer enter the inheritance/`get_parents()`/`get_relatives()` data model.
2. **`ChooseAdoptiveParentScreen.py`** — the entry loop now uses `isinstance(parent_ob, Cat)` before touching `.faded` (and I removed a stray `Cat.fetch_cat(parent_ob)` that redundantly re-fetched an already-fetched object).
3. **`ProfileScreen.py`** — the "parents:" list now filters to valid `Cat` objects, matching the sibling/offspring pattern already used a few lines below.

## Verification

- Reproduced both crash sites before the fix, confirmed both are gone after (dangling parent is now filtered / guarded).
- `tests.test_cat`, `tests.test_save`, `tests.test_relation_events` all pass.

One caveat worth flagging: I could reproduce the crash reliably by injecting a dangling parent reference, but I couldn't reconstruct the exact save sequence that *creates* one during normal play from the report alone. The fixes harden every path that consumes parent references, so the game no longer crashes regardless of how the bad reference arose — but if you have the save file, it'd be worth confirming there against it.
